summary: Ground every explicit RFI/Submittal identifier in its own answer citations or citation locators.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email efficiency, accuracy and adaptability
The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files
An offline reproduction proved that numeric grounding alone accepted RFI 43 cited to RFI 42 when an unrelated 43 appeared in the same passage
approval_evidence: The persistent objective and project-question request authorize this deterministic answer-accuracy improvement.
known_limitations: The guard validates explicit RFI/Submittal identities; it does not infer an identity from ordinary numbers or non-workflow prose.
Pure-numeric RFI leading zeros are equivalent, while prefixed, compound and Submittal identifiers remain exact.
A citation locator may ground numeric occurrences inside the exact matched workflow identity only; every occurrence outside the identity remains quote-bound even when it has the same value.
The guard does not infer chronology, authority, contractual meaning or whether all project documents were uploaded.
